WITH toy_daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
    WHERE pt.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT DATE '2017-01-01' + INTERVAL (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY 1) - 1) DAY AS dt
    FROM (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION 
          SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10) t1,
         (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION 
          SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10) t2,
         (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION 
          SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10) t3,
         (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION 
          SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10) t4,
         (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION 
          SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10) t5
),
daily_with_daynum AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.dt AS order_date,
        COALESCE(tds.daily_sales, 0) AS daily_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ad.dt) AS day_num
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN toy_daily_sales tds ON ad.dt = tds.order_date
    WHERE ad.dt >= '2017-01-01' AND ad.dt <= '2018-08-29'
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) AS intercept
    FROM daily_with_daynum
),
target_dates AS (
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-03' AS target_date UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-04' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-05' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-06' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-07' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-08' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-09' UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-10'
),
target_with_daynum AS (
    SELECT 
        td.target_date,
        (SELECT MAX(day_num) FROM daily_with_daynum) + 
            CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (td.target_date - (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM daily_with_daynum))) AS INTEGER) AS day_num
    FROM target_dates td
),
predicted_targets AS (
    SELECT 
        twd.target_date,
        twd.day_num,
        r.slope * twd.day_num + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM target_with_daynum twd
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
ma AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.target_date,
        p1.predicted_sales AS day_predicted,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) AS moving_average_5day
    FROM (
        SELECT DATE '2018-12-05' AS target_date UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE '2018-12-06' UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE '2018-12-07' UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE '2018-12-08'
    ) pd
    JOIN predicted_targets p1 ON pd.target_date = p1.target_date
    JOIN predicted_targets p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p1.day_num - 2 AND p1.day_num + 2
    GROUP BY pd.target_date, p1.predicted_sales
)
SELECT SUM(moving_average_5day) AS sum_of_5day_moving_averages
FROM ma

-- Final RFM analysis: average sales per order by RFM segment
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_id,
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_purchase_ts,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_value), 0) AS order_total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_id, CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)
),
customer_rfm_raw AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        CAST(date_diff('day', MAX(order_purchase_ts), (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_ts) FROM delivered_orders)) AS BIGINT) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(order_total) AS monetary,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
customer_rfm_scored AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        total_orders,
        ROUND(1.0 * monetary / total_orders, 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_rfm_raw
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        (r_score * 100 + f_score * 10 + m_score) AS rfm_score,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        CASE
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
              OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS segment
    FROM customer_rfm_scored
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days,
    ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_frequency,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_monetary,
    ROUND(SUM(monetary), 2) AS total_monetary
FROM customer_segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

WITH order_payments_agg AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) as total_payment
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as num_orders,
    AVG(op.total_payment) as avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE 
      WHEN date_diff('day', CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 7.0 < 1.0 
      THEN 1.0
      ELSE date_diff('day', CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 7.0
    END as lifespan_weeks
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments_agg op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id, num_orders, avg_payment_per_order, lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(
    ROUND(1.0 * ABS(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))), 2) 
    + ROUND(1.0 * ABS(((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))) % 12), 2) / 12.0 
    + ROUND(1.0 * ABS(DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(DATE_ADD(CAST(debut AS DATE), INTERVAL ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(final_game AS DATE)) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(debut AS DATE))) MONTH) AS DATE), CAST(final_game AS DATE))), 2) / 365.0
  ), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM player
WHERE debut != '' AND final_game != ''

WITH abakan_airport AS (
  SELECT airport_code FROM airports_data WHERE city LIKE '%Abakan%'
),
relevant_flights AS (
  SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport
  FROM flights f
  WHERE f.departure_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airport)
     OR f.arrival_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airport)
),
relevant_airports AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT departure_airport as ap FROM relevant_flights
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT arrival_airport as ap FROM relevant_flights
),
airport_coords AS (
  SELECT r.ap as airport_code,
         TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(a.coordinates::VARCHAR, '(', 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as lon,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(a.coordinates::VARCHAR, '(', 2), ',', 2), ')') AS DOUBLE) as lat
  FROM relevant_airports r
  JOIN airports_data a ON r.ap = a.airport_code
),
flights_with_coords AS (
  SELECT rf.flight_id, rf.departure_airport, rf.arrival_airport,
         dep.lon as dep_lon, dep.lat as dep_lat,
         arr.lon as arr_lon, arr.lat as arr_lat
  FROM relevant_flights rf
  JOIN airport_coords dep ON rf.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airport_coords arr ON rf.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
distances AS (
  SELECT flight_id, departure_airport, arrival_airport,
         6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
           POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
           COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
           POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
         )) as distance_km
  FROM flights_with_coords
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(distance_km), 2) as distance_km FROM distances

WITH airports AS (
  SELECT 
    airport_code,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(city, '^.*"en"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)".*$', '\1') as city,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as longitude,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(TRY_CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as latitude
  FROM airports_data
),
flight_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport,
    f.arrival_airport,
    dep.city as from_city,
    arr.city as to_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((arr.latitude - dep.latitude) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
      COS(dep.latitude * PI() / 180) * COS(arr.latitude * PI() / 180) *
      POWER(SIN((arr.longitude - dep.longitude) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
    )) as distance
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    LEAST(from_city, to_city) as city1,
    GREATEST(from_city, to_city) as city2,
    distance
  FROM flight_distances
),
avg_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance) as avg_distance
  FROM city_pairs
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
with_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0-999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000-1999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000-2999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000-3999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000-4999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000-5999'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END as distance_range
  FROM avg_distances
)
SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) as pair_count
FROM with_ranges
GROUP BY distance_range
ORDER BY pair_count, distance_range

WITH motorcycle_collisions AS (
    SELECT case_id, motorcyclist_killed_count 
    FROM collisions 
    WHERE motorcycle_collision = 1
),
party_helmet AS (
    SELECT 
        p.case_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_2) LIKE '%helmet used%' OR LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_1) LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN 'helmet_used'
            WHEN LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_2) LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_1) LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN 'helmet_not_used'
            ELSE NULL
        END as helmet_status
    FROM parties p
    WHERE LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_2) LIKE '%helmet%' 
       OR LOWER(p.party_safety_equipment_1) LIKE '%helmet%'
),
collision_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.case_id,
        mc.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(ph.helmet_status) as helmet_group
    FROM motorcycle_collisions mc
    LEFT JOIN party_helmet ph ON mc.case_id = ph.case_id
    GROUP BY mc.case_id, mc.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN helmet_group = 'helmet_used' THEN 'helmet used'
        WHEN helmet_group = 'helmet_not_used' THEN 'helmet not used'
    END as helmet_usage_group,
    total_collisions,
    motorcyclist_fatalities,
    ROUND(1.0 * motorcyclist_fatalities / total_collisions * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(helmet_group, 'no_helmet_info') as helmet_group,
        COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
        SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) as motorcyclist_fatalities
    FROM collision_groups
    GROUP BY 1
) sub
WHERE helmet_group IN ('helmet_used', 'helmet_not_used')
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN helmet_group = 'helmet_used' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

WITH yearly_top2 AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year, pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER), pcf_violation_category
),
top2_years AS (
  SELECT year, STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ',') AS causes
  FROM yearly_top2 
  WHERE rn <= 2 
  GROUP BY year
),
overall_top2 AS (
  SELECT STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ',') AS causes
  FROM (
    SELECT pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM collisions
    WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
    GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 2
  )
)
SELECT * FROM top2_years

WITH year_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_collisions
  FROM collisions
  WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2011, 2021)
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
speeding_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS cat_count
  FROM collisions
  WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2011, 2021)
    AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
  'speeding' AS pcf_violation_category,
  ROUND(s1.cat_count * 100.0 / t1.total_collisions, 2) AS share_2011_pct,
  ROUND(s2.cat_count * 100.0 / t2.total_collisions, 2) AS share_2021_pct,
  ROUND((s1.cat_count * 100.0 / t1.total_collisions) - (s2.cat_count * 100.0 / t2.total_collisions), 2) AS decrease_pct_points
FROM speeding_counts s1
JOIN year_totals t1 ON s1.year = t1.year AND s1.year = 2011
JOIN speeding_counts s2 ON s2.year = 2021
JOIN year_totals t2 ON s2.year = t2.year AND s2.year = 2021

SELECT w1.name as winner_name, w2.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON CAST(m.title_id AS INTEGER) = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = CAST(w1.id AS VARCHAR)
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = CAST(w2.id AS VARCHAR)
WHERE b.name = 'NXT Championship'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration = '00:43'
LIMIT 1

-- Use RANK to handle ties, then limit to 3
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs,
        MODE(b.bowler) as bowler
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no
),
max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        orr.match_id,
        orr.over_id,
        orr.innings_no,
        orr.total_runs,
        orr.bowler
    FROM over_runs orr
    JOIN max_over_runs mor ON orr.match_id = mor.match_id AND orr.total_runs = mor.max_runs
),
bowler_max_over AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM max_over_bowler_runs
)
SELECT 
    bmr.bowler as player_id,
    p.player_name,
    bmr.match_id,
    CAST(bmr.total_runs AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max_over bmr
JOIN player p ON bmr.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bmr.rn = 1
ORDER BY bmr.total_runs DESC, bmr.bowler ASC
LIMIT 3

-- Final check: all bowlers with 0 bowling average (0 runs conceded, at least 1 wicket)
WITH runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
extras_conceded AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) as total_extras
    FROM extra_runs e
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wickets_taken AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    rc.total_runs,
    COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0) as total_extras,
    rc.total_runs + COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    wt.total_wickets
FROM runs_conceded rc
JOIN wickets_taken wt ON rc.bowler = wt.bowler
LEFT JOIN extras_conceded ec ON rc.bowler = ec.bowler
JOIN player p ON rc.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE (rc.total_runs + COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0)) = 0 AND wt.total_wickets > 0

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
  SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker
  FROM striker_match_runs
  WHERE match_total_runs > 50
)
SELECT AVG(st.total_runs) as avg_total_runs
FROM (
  SELECT s.striker, SUM(smr.match_total_runs) as total_runs
  FROM qualifying_strikers s
  JOIN striker_match_runs smr ON s.striker = smr.striker
  GROUP BY s.striker
) st

-- Final answer: distinct player names
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM batsman_scored bsb
JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bsb.match_id = bb.match_id AND bsb.over_id = bb.over_id AND bsb.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bsb.innings_no = bb.innings_no
JOIN player_match pm ON bsb.match_id = pm.match_id AND bb.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON bsb.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pm.team_id != m.match_winner
GROUP BY bsb.match_id, bb.striker, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(bsb.runs_scored) >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name

-- Final query: Top 5 players by average runs per match in season 5
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id, pl.player_name, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN player pl ON b.striker = pl.player_id
    JOIN season5_matches m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY b.striker, pl.player_name
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN season5_matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT wt.player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt

    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip
  FROM distinct_locations
),
with_distance AS (
  SELECT 
    prev_state, prev_city, prev_zip, prev_lat, prev_lng,
    geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng,
    6371 * ACOS(
      GREATEST(-1, LEAST(1,
        COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(prev_lng)) +
        SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(geolocation_lat))
      ))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM ordered_locations
  WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL
)

WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE sales_2019 > 0
        AND sales_2020 >= sales_2019 * 1.2
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, p.prod_name
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name, total_sales
    FROM product_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (

        customer_id,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            ELSE -txn_amount 
        END) as net_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
customer_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as earliest_date,
        MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as latest_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        cdr.customer_id,
        d as txn_date
    FROM customer_date_ranges cdr,
    UNNEST(generate_series(cdr.earliest_date, cdr.latest_date, INTERVAL '1 day')) AS t(d)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.customer_id,
        ad.txn_date,
        COALESCE(dc.net_change, 0) as net_change
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc 
        ON ad.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = dc.txn_date
),
running_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        net_change,
        SUM(net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as raw_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
final_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        GREATEST(raw_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM running_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date) as month,
        customer_id,
        MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM final_balances
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date), customer_id
)
SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE page_id = 13 AND event_type = 3
),
product_events AS (
    SELECT

        ph.product_id,
        ph.page_name AS product_name,
        se.event_type,
        ei.event_name
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON se.page_id = ph.page_id
    JOIN shopping_cart_event_identifier ei ON se.event_type = ei.event_type
    WHERE ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
views AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name, COUNT(*) as view_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_name = 'Page View'
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name
),
added_to_cart AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name, COUNT(*) as add_to_cart_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_name = 'Add to Cart'
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name
),
cart_in_purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT pe.product_id, pe.product_name, COUNT(*) as purchased_count
    FROM product_events pe
    JOIN purchase_visits pv ON pe.visit_id = pv.visit_id
    WHERE pe.event_name = 'Add to Cart'
    GROUP BY pe.product_id, pe.product_name
),
cart_not_purchased AS (
    SELECT pe.product_id, pe.product_name, COUNT(*) as left_in_cart_count
    FROM product_events pe
    LEFT JOIN purchase_visits pv ON pe.visit_id = pv.visit_id
    WHERE pe.event_name = 'Add to Cart'
      AND pv.visit_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY pe.product_id, pe.product_name
)
SELECT 
    v.product_id,
    v.product_name,
    v.view_count AS times_viewed,
    a.add_to_cart_count AS times_added_to_cart,
    cp.left_in_cart_count AS times_left_in_cart_without_purchase,
    COALESCE(pp.purchased_count, 0) AS actual_purchases
FROM views v
JOIN added_to_cart a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN cart_not_purchased cp ON v.product_id = cp.product_id
LEFT JOIN cart_in_purchase_visits pp ON v.product_id = pp.product_id
ORDER BY v.product_id

-- Full query: monthly max index composition with rolling average and lagged values
WITH monthly_avgs AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_comp_index
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE (month_year IS NOT NULL)
      AND (( _year = 2018 AND _month >= 9) OR (_year = 2019 AND _month <= 8))
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_comp_index,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_comp_index DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avgs
),
top_interests AS (
    SELECT mm.month_year, mm.interest_id, mm.avg_comp_index as max_index_comp, im.interest_name
    FROM monthly_max mm
    JOIN interest_map im ON mm.interest_id = im.id
    WHERE mm.rn = 1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT t.month_year, t.interest_name, t.max_index_comp,
           AVG(t.max_index_comp) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
               ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_3m,
           LAG(t.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev_interest_name,
           LAG(t.max_index_comp, 1) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev_max_index_comp,
           LAG(t.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev2_interest_name,
           LAG(t.max_index_comp, 2) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev2_max_index_comp
    FROM top_interests t
)
SELECT month_year, interest_name, max_index_comp, rolling_avg_3m,
       prev_interest_name, prev_max_index_comp,
       prev2_interest_name, prev2_max_index_comp
FROM ordered
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)

WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year) as rn
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.month_year IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.month_year,
        mc.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition DESC) as top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition ASC) as bottom_rank
    FROM max_composition mc
)
SELECT 
    r.month_year AS "time",
    m.interest_name AS "interest_name",
    r.composition AS "composition"
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map m ON r.interest_id = m.id
WHERE r.top_rank <= 10 OR r.bottom_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.composition DESC

customer_groups AS (

-- Final query: For each year, calculate percentage of movies with exclusively female actors
WITH movie_cast_genders AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.MID,

    FROM M_Cast mc

    WHERE p.Gender IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.Gender) != ''
),
movie_gender_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        MID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_female,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Gender != 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_non_female
    FROM movie_cast_genders
    GROUP BY MID
),
movie_exclusively_female AS (
    SELECT 
        MID,
        CASE WHEN has_female = 1 AND has_non_female = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_exclusively_female
    FROM movie_gender_summary
),
year_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        COUNT(*) as total_movies,
        COALESCE(SUM(mef.is_exclusively_female), 0) as exclusive_female_count
    FROM Movie m
    LEFT JOIN movie_exclusively_female mef ON m.MID = mef.MID
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
    year,
    total_movies,
    1.0 * exclusive_female_count / total_movies * 100 as percentage
FROM year_stats
ORDER BY year

WITH distinct_years AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) AS numeric_year
    FROM Movie
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY numeric_year
),
movie_years AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) AS myear
    FROM Movie
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    dy.numeric_year AS start_year,
    COUNT(my.myear) AS film_count
FROM distinct_years dy
LEFT JOIN movie_years my ON my.myear >= dy.numeric_year AND my.myear <= dy.numeric_year + 9
GROUP BY dy.numeric_year
HAVING COUNT(my.myear) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(my2.myear) AS cnt
        FROM distinct_years dy2
        LEFT JOIN movie_years my2 ON my2.myear >= dy2.numeric_year AND my2.myear <= dy2.numeric_year + 9
        GROUP BY dy2.numeric_year
    )
)
ORDER BY start_year ASC

WITH actor_years AS (

    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID

actor_year_counts AS (

    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY PID
),
ranked AS (

           LAG(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) AS prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),
max_gaps AS (

    FROM ranked

    GROUP BY PID

WITH region_summary AS (

    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wa.sales_rep_id = sr.id

),
rep_totals AS (

        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales,

    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wa.sales_rep_id = sr.id

    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name

WITH english_classes AS (
    SELECT c.ClassID

    JOIN Subjects s ON c.SubjectID = s.SubjectID

),
completed_english AS (
    SELECT ss.StudentID, ss.Grade
    FROM Student_Schedules ss
    JOIN english_classes ec ON ss.ClassID = ec.ClassID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2 AND ss.Grade IS NOT NULL
),
student_avg AS (
    SELECT StudentID, AVG(Grade) AS avg_grade
    FROM completed_english
    GROUP BY StudentID
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_students FROM student_avg
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        sa.StudentID,
        sa.avg_grade,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_avg sa2 WHERE sa2.avg_grade >= sa.avg_grade) AS rank_num,
        tc.total_students,
        1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_avg sa2 WHERE sa2.avg_grade >= sa.avg_grade) / tc.total_students AS rank_fraction
    FROM student_avg sa
    CROSS JOIN total_count tc
)
SELECT 
    r.StudentID,
    s.StudLastName,
    r.avg_grade,
    r.rank_fraction,
    CASE 
        WHEN r.rank_fraction <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
        WHEN r.rank_fraction <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'

ORDER BY r.rank_fraction ASC

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
)
SELECT

WITH cust_prefs AS (

  FROM Musical_Preferences
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) IS NOT NULL 
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) IS NOT NULL
),
ent_styles_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    EntertainerID,
    StyleID,
    StyleStrength,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC, StyleID) AS rn
  FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
ent_strengths AS (
  SELECT 
    EntertainerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS strength1,

  FROM ent_styles_ranked
  GROUP BY EntertainerID
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) IS NOT NULL

)
SELECT DISTINCT

WITH annual_sales AS (

           CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as sales_year,

    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER), CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT BusinessEntityID,
           CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as quota_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) as annual_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT s.businessentityid,
       COALESCE(s.sales_year, q.quota_year) as year,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0), 2) as total_sales,
       ROUND(COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0), 2) as annual_quota,
       ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0), 2) as sales_vs_quota_difference
FROM annual_sales s
FULL OUTER JOIN annual_quota q ON s.businessentityid = q.BusinessEntityID AND s.sales_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY s.businessentityid, year

WITH director_movies AS (

    FROM director_mapping dm

),
director_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        date_published,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        date_published,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (date_published - prev_date)) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE NULL
        END as inter_movie_duration_days
    FROM director_with_lag
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,

        CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(inter_movie_duration_days), 0)) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,

    FROM inter_movie_diff

)
SELECT

    avg_inter_movie_duration,
    avg_rating,

-- Final query with proper formatting
WITH txn_data AS (
    SELECT 
        bm.region,
        TRY_CAST(split_part(bt.txn_date, '-', 3) AS INTEGER) as txn_year,
        bt.quantity,
        bp.price,
        bt.quantity * bp.price as dollar_amount
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.txn_date = bp.market_date AND bt.ticker = bp.ticker
    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
),
annual_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        ROUND(SUM(dollar_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(quantity), 2) as avg_price
    FROM txn_data
    GROUP BY region, txn_year
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM annual_agg
    WHERE txn_year > (SELECT MIN(txn_year) FROM annual_agg aa WHERE aa.region = annual_agg.region)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_price DESC) as price_rank,
        LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_avg_price
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    avg_price,
    price_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_avg_price IS NULL THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND((avg_price - prev_avg_price) * 100.0 / prev_avg_price, 2) 
    END as pct_change
FROM ranked
ORDER BY txn_year, price_rank

WITH converted AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    volume,
    CASE 
      WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
      WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
      WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
      ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
    END AS numeric_volume
  FROM bitcoin_prices
  WHERE market_date IN ('01-08-2021','02-08-2021','03-08-2021','04-08-2021','05-08-2021','06-08-2021','07-08-2021','08-08-2021','09-08-2021','10-08-2021')
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    numeric_volume,
    LAG(numeric_volume) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date) AS prev_volume
  FROM converted
)
SELECT 
  ticker,
  market_date,
  ROUND(1.0 * (numeric_volume - prev_volume) / prev_volume * 100, 2) AS daily_pct_change
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_volume IS NOT NULL AND prev_volume != 0 AND numeric_volume != 0

WITH first_terms AS (

    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.gender,
        ft.state,
        ft.first_term_start,
        interval_years,
        CAST(
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (ft.first_term_start + interval_years * INTERVAL '1 year')) || 
            '-12-31' AS DATE
        ) as check_date,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt.term_start::DATE <= CAST(
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (ft.first_term_start + interval_years * INTERVAL '1 year')) || 
                '-12-31' AS DATE
            ) 
            AND lt.term_end::DATE >= CAST(
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (ft.first_term_start + interval_years * INTERVAL '1 year')) || 
                '-12-31' AS DATE
            )
        ) as retained
    FROM first_terms ft,
    (SELECT UNNEST([0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10]) as interval_years) intervals
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT state, gender, interval_years, 
           COUNT(*) as total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_count,
           1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, interval_years
),
state_gender_valid AS (
    SELECT state, gender
    FROM retention_rates
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING MIN(retention_rate) > 0
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT interval_years) = 6
)

WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
           SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) AS prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_payments
),
mom_diffs AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) AS mom_diff
    FROM with_lag
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name,
           payment_month,
           mom_diff,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mom_diff DESC) AS rn
    FROM mom_diffs m
    JOIN customer c ON m.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id,
       customer_name,
       strftime('%Y-%m', payment_month) AS month,
       mom_diff

         STRING_AGG(c, '' ORDER BY c) AS signature

  FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL AND home_team_goal != away_team_goal
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT pm.player_api_id, p.player_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pm.result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pm.result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses
  FROM player_matches pm
  JOIN Player p ON pm.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  GROUP BY pm.player_api_id, p.player_name
)
SELECT 'highest_wins' as category, player_name, CAST(wins AS INTEGER) as match_count
FROM player_stats
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wins DESC) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'highest_losses' as category, player_name, CAST(losses AS INTEGER) as match_count
FROM player_stats
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY losses DESC) = 1

-- Full query with clean integer output
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.innings_no,
        bbb.striker,
        bbb.non_striker,
        CAST(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS BIGINT) AS striker_runs,
        CAST(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS BIGINT) AS extra_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
        ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
player_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        striker AS player_id,
        SUM(striker_runs) AS individual_score
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker
),
pair_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        GREATEST(striker, non_striker) AS p1_raw,
        LEAST(striker, non_striker) AS p2_raw,
        SUM(striker_runs + extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, striker, non_striker
),
pair_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        p1_raw,
        p2_raw,
        SUM(partnership_runs) AS total_partnership_runs
    FROM pair_partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id, p1_raw, p2_raw
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_partnership_runs) AS max_partnership
    FROM pair_totals
    GROUP BY match_id
),
best_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.match_id,
        pt.p1_raw,
        pt.p2_raw,
        pt.total_partnership_runs AS partnership_score,
        COALESCE(ps1.individual_score, 0) AS p1_score,
        COALESCE(ps2.individual_score, 0) AS p2_score
    FROM pair_totals pt
    JOIN max_partnerships mp ON pt.match_id = mp.match_id AND pt.total_partnership_runs = mp.max_partnership
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps1 ON pt.match_id = ps1.match_id AND pt.p1_raw = ps1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps2 ON pt.match_id = ps2.match_id AND pt.p2_raw = ps2.player_id
),
final_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p1_raw ELSE p2_raw END AS player1,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p2_raw ELSE p1_raw END AS player2,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p1_score ELSE p2_score END AS score1,
        CASE WHEN p1_score > p2_score OR (p1_score = p2_score AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p2_score ELSE p1_score END AS score2,
        partnership_score
    FROM best_pairs
)
SELECT 
    CAST(match_id AS BIGINT) AS match_id,
    CAST(player1 AS BIGINT) AS player1,
    CAST(score1 AS BIGINT) AS score1,
    CAST(player2 AS BIGINT) AS player2,
    CAST(score2 AS BIGINT) AS score2,
    CAST(partnership_score AS BIGINT) AS partnership_score
FROM final_pairs
ORDER BY match_id, player1, player2

classified AS (

WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack' AND step IN (1, 2, 3)
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack' AND step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
occurrences AS (
    SELECT s.name, s.version, s.step,
           CASE WHEN n.max_non_stack_score < s.stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lower
    FROM stack_scores s
    JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
),
occurrence_counts AS (
    SELECT name, SUM(is_lower) AS occurrence_count
    FROM occurrences
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT o.name, o.occurrence_count, s.solution_count
FROM occurrence_counts o
JOIN solution_counts s ON o.name = s.name
WHERE o.occurrence_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY o.occurrence_count DESC

WITH step_data AS (
  SELECT name, version, step,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_non_stack_score
  FROM model_score
  GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_status AS (
  SELECT name, version,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stack_score > max_non_stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_strong,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stack_score = max_non_stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_soft
  FROM step_data
  GROUP BY name, version
),
model_with_l1 AS (
  SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.has_strong, ms.has_soft, m.L1_model
  FROM model_status ms
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model FROM model) m 
    ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
),
status_l1_counts AS (

  FROM model_with_l1
  GROUP BY L1_model

  SELECT 'soft' as status, L1_model, SUM(has_soft) as cnt

),
ranked AS (

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
    pr.contains_id AS current_id,
    pr.qty AS level_qty,
    1 AS depth
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations EXCEPT SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pt.level_qty * pr.qty,
    pt.depth + 1
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
),
leaf_ids AS (
  SELECT contains_id AS leaf_id FROM packaging_relations
  EXCEPT
  SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
),
leaf_quantities AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.top_id,
    SUM(pt.level_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN leaf_ids li ON li.leaf_id = pt.current_id
  GROUP BY pt.top_id
)
SELECT top_id, total_leaf_qty FROM leaf_quantities ORDER BY top_id

-- Recursive CTE to find all leaf items under each top-level container
-- and compute the accumulated quantity, then filter for total > 500
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        tl.id AS top_id,
        tl.name AS top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS running_qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging tl
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON tl.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE tl.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.running_qty * pr.qty AS running_qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.leaf_id,
        SUM(h.running_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    WHERE h.leaf_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY h.top_id, h.leaf_id
)
SELECT 
    p_top.name AS container_name,
    p_leaf.name AS item_name,
    a.total_qty
FROM aggregated a
JOIN packaging p_top ON a.top_id = p_top.id
JOIN packaging p_leaf ON a.leaf_id = p_leaf.id
WHERE a.total_qty > 500
ORDER BY container_name, item_name;

WITH order_lines AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
  FROM orderlines
  WHERE order_id = 423
  GROUP BY product_id
),
inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.product_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty, p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) AS rn
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
  JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
  WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
inv_with_cum AS (
  SELECT inv.*, 
    SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.purchased, inv.qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_qty,
    SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.purchased, inv.qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) - inv.qty AS prev_cumulative_qty
  FROM inv
)
SELECT 
  inv.product_id,
  inv.aisle,
  inv.position,
  CASE 
    WHEN inv.prev_cumulative_qty >= ol.total_qty THEN 0
    WHEN inv.cumulative_qty <= ol.total_qty THEN inv.qty
    ELSE ol.total_qty - inv.prev_cumulative_qty
  END AS qty_to_pick
FROM inv_with_cum inv
JOIN order_lines ol ON inv.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE inv.prev_cumulative_qty < ol.total_qty
ORDER BY inv.product_id, inv.purchased, inv.qty

WITH order_lines AS (

    FROM orderlines ol

inv_total AS (

    GROUP BY i.product_id
),
ord_cumulative AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name, order_id, ord_rank, req_qty, 
           SUM(req_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ord_rank) as cum_demand
    FROM order_lines
),
pick_calc AS (
    SELECT o.product_id, o.product_name, o.ord_rank, o.order_id, o.req_qty, o.cum_demand,
           t.total_inv,
           LAG(o.cum_demand) OVER (PARTITION BY o.product_id ORDER BY o.ord_rank) as prev_demand
    FROM ord_cumulative o
    JOIN inv_total t ON o.product_id = t.product_id
),
pick_amounts AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name, ord_rank, order_id, req_qty, cum_demand,
           total_inv, prev_demand,
           GREATEST(0, LEAST(total_inv, cum_demand) - COALESCE(prev_demand, 0)) as picked_qty
    FROM pick_calc
)
SELECT product_name, order_id, req_qty, picked_qty, total_inv, cum_demand, prev_demand,
       ROUND(100.0 * picked_qty / req_qty, 2) as pick_pct
FROM pick_amounts
ORDER BY product_name, ord_rank

WITH ordered_sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS month_num
    FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        o1.product_id,
        o1.mth,
        o1.qty AS actual_sales,
        o1.month_num,
        (SELECT AVG(o2.qty) FROM ordered_sales o2 
         WHERE o2.product_id = o1.product_id 
         AND o2.month_num BETWEEN o1.month_num - 5 AND o1.month_num + 6) AS window1_avg,
        (SELECT AVG(o3.qty) FROM ordered_sales o3 
         WHERE o3.product_id = o1.product_id 
         AND o3.month_num BETWEEN o1.month_num - 6 AND o1.month_num + 5) AS window2_avg
    FROM ordered_sales o1
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, month_num, actual_sales,
           (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma,
           actual_sales / ((window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0) AS sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE month_num BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
monthly_2017 AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM ratios
    WHERE mth >= '2017-01-01' AND mth <= '2017-12-01'
)
SELECT p.id, p.name
FROM products p
INNER JOIN monthly_2017 m ON p.id = m.product_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING MIN(m.sales_to_cma_ratio) > 2

WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, mth, qty, time_step,
        LAG(qty, 1) OVER w AS lag1, LAG(qty, 2) OVER w AS lag2,
        LAG(qty, 3) OVER w AS lag3, LAG(qty, 4) OVER w AS lag4,
        LAG(qty, 5) OVER w AS lag5, LAG(qty, 6) OVER w AS lag6,
        LEAD(qty, 1) OVER w AS lead1, LEAD(qty, 2) OVER w AS lead2,
        LEAD(qty, 3) OVER w AS lead3, LEAD(qty, 4) OVER w AS lead4,
        LEAD(qty, 5) OVER w AS lead5, LEAD(qty, 6) OVER w AS lead6
    FROM monthly_data
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY time_step)
),
with_cma AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, mth, qty, time_step,
        (COALESCE(lag5,0) + COALESCE(lag4,0) + COALESCE(lag3,0) + COALESCE(lag2,0) + COALESCE(lag1,0) + qty + COALESCE(lead1,0) + COALESCE(lead2,0) + COALESCE(lead3,0) + COALESCE(lead4,0) + COALESCE(lead5,0) + COALESCE(lead6,0) 
         + COALESCE(lag6,0) + COALESCE(lag5,0) + COALESCE(lag4,0) + COALESCE(lag3,0) + COALESCE(lag2,0) + COALESCE(lag1,0) + qty + COALESCE(lead1,0) + COALESCE(lead2,0) + COALESCE(lead3,0) + COALESCE(lead4,0) + COALESCE(lead5,0) + lead6) / 24.0 AS cma
    FROM with_windows
),
with_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, mth, qty, time_step, cma,
        CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN qty * 1.0 / cma ELSE NULL END AS ratio,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) AS month_of_year
    FROM with_cma
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM with_ratio
    GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
seasonality_norm AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        avg_ratio * 12.0 / SUM(avg_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS norm_ratio
    FROM seasonality
),
all_data AS (
    SELECT 
        md.product_id, md.mth, md.qty, md.time_step,
        sn.norm_ratio AS seasonality_index,
        CASE WHEN sn.norm_ratio > 0 THEN md.qty * 1.0 / sn.norm_ratio ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized_qty,
        wc.cma
    FROM monthly_data md
    JOIN seasonality_norm sn ON md.product_id = sn.product_id AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(md.mth AS DATE)) = sn.month_of_year
    LEFT JOIN with_cma wc ON md.product_id = wc.product_id AND md.mth = wc.mth
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(cma) AS W,
        SUM(cma * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wxy,
        SUM(cma * time_step * time_step) AS sum_wxx,
        SUM(cma * time_step) AS sum_wx,
        SUM(cma * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wy
    FROM all_data
    WHERE deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
weighted_regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        (sum_wxy - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wy) / (sum_wxx - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wx) AS slope,
        (sum_wy / W) - (sum_wx / W) * ((sum_wxy - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wy) / (sum_wxx - (sum_wx / W) * sum_wx)) AS intercept
    FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast_months AS (
    SELECT product_id, month_of_year, norm_ratio FROM seasonality_norm
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.product_id,
        fm.month_of_year,
        fm.norm_ratio AS seasonality_index,
        ROUND((wr.intercept + wr.slope * (24 + fm.month_of_year)) * fm.norm_ratio, 2) AS forecasted_monthly
    FROM weighted_regression wr
    JOIN forecast_months fm ON wr.product_id = fm.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, 
       ROUND(SUM(forecasted_monthly), 2) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH RECURSIVE month_seq AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month_num, DATE '2019-01-01' AS mth
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month_num + 1, mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
    FROM month_seq
    WHERE month_num < 12
),
products AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty_minimum, qty_purchase
    FROM product_minimums
),
start_inv AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty AS starting_inv
    FROM inventory_totals
    WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM product_minimums)
),
inventory_model AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        ms.month_num,
        ms.mth,
        CASE 
            WHEN si.starting_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) >= p.qty_minimum 
            THEN si.starting_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0)
            ELSE si.starting_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) + p.qty_purchase
        END AS ending_inv
    FROM products p
    JOIN start_inv si ON si.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN month_seq ms ON ms.month_num = 1
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = p.product_id AND mb.mth = ms.mth
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        ms.month_num,
        ms.mth,
        CASE 
            WHEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) >= p.qty_minimum 
            THEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0)
            ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) + p.qty_purchase
        END AS ending_inv
    FROM inventory_model im
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = im.product_id
    JOIN month_seq ms ON ms.month_num = im.month_num + 1
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = p.product_id AND mb.mth = ms.mth
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        im.mth,
        im.ending_inv,
        p.qty_minimum,
        ABS(im.ending_inv - p.qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inventory_model im
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = im.product_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, mth, ending_inv, qty_minimum, abs_diff,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff ASC, mth ASC) AS rn
    FROM with_diff
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id

WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        t1.team_long_name AS home_team,
        t2.team_long_name AS away_team,
        m.home_team_goal,
        m.away_team_goal,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3 
             WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 END AS home_points,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3 
             WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 END AS away_points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t1 ON m.home_team_api_id = t1.team_api_id
    JOIN Team t2 ON m.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
),
team_season_points AS (
    SELECT season, league, country, home_team AS team, SUM(home_points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league, country, home_team
    UNION ALL
    SELECT season, league, country, away_team AS team, SUM(away_points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league, country, away_team
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT season, league, country, team, total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_season_points
)
SELECT season, league, country, team, CAST(total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, league

WITH stats AS (

  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
),
items AS (

    (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) AS avg_lr,

  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(avg_lr, 4) AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < avg_lr - sd_lr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_one_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= avg_lr - sd_lr AND "loss_rate_%" <= avg_lr + sd_lr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_one_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > avg_lr + sd_lr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_one_stddev
FROM items

        ) as avg_packing_time_days

WITH weekly_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        week_date,
        SUM(sales) AS total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY calendar_year, week_date
),
with_direction AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        week_date,
        total_sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) < DATE '2018-06-15' + (calendar_year - 2018) * INTERVAL '1' YEAR THEN 'before'
            WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) > DATE '2018-06-15' + (calendar_year - 2018) * INTERVAL '1' YEAR THEN 'after'
            ELSE 'same'
        END AS direction
    FROM weekly_sales_agg
),
selected_weeks AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        direction,
        week_date,
        total_sales
    FROM with_direction
    WHERE direction IN ('before', 'after')
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY calendar_year, direction 
        ORDER BY 
            CASE WHEN direction = 'before' THEN week_date END DESC,
            CASE WHEN direction = 'after' THEN week_date END ASC
    ) <= 4
),
period_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'before' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS pre_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'after' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS post_sales
    FROM selected_weeks
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    pre_sales,
    post_sales,
    ROUND(1.0 * (post_sales - pre_sales) / pre_sales * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM period_totals
ORDER BY calendar_year

platform_stats AS (

    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales

),
age_band_stats AS (

  FROM (

demographic_stats AS (

customer_type_stats AS (

FROM (

landing AS (

  WHERE stamp = (SELECT MAX(stamp) FROM deduped WHERE session = d.session)

-- Find pairs where both are /detail (exact match, with or without trailing slash)

    JOIN ranked r2 ON r1.session = r2.session AND r2.rn = r1.rn + 1
    JOIN ranked r3 ON r1.session = r3.session AND r3.rn = r1.rn + 2
    WHERE (r1.path = '/detail' OR r1.path = '/detail/')

WITH user_ages AS (

    CAST(birth_date AS DATE) as birth_date_cast,

  FROM mst_users

categorized AS (

      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'

-- Final query: return qualifying sessions with their path and search_type of first pre-click event
WITH distinct_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, action, option, path, search_type 
  FROM activity_log
),
first_detail_complete AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_detail_stamp
  FROM distinct_events
  WHERE path = '/detail' OR path = '/detail/' OR path = '/complete'
  GROUP BY session
),
pre_events AS (
  SELECT de.session, de.stamp, de.path, de.search_type
  FROM distinct_events de
  JOIN first_detail_complete fdc ON de.session = fdc.session
  WHERE de.stamp < fdc.first_detail_stamp
    AND de.search_type <> ''
),
session_counts AS (
  SELECT session, COUNT(*) as pre_click_count
  FROM pre_events
  GROUP BY session
),
min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) as min_cnt
  FROM session_counts
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
  SELECT sc.session, sc.pre_click_count
  FROM session_counts sc, min_count mc
  WHERE sc.pre_click_count = mc.min_cnt
),
first_pre_event AS (
  SELECT session, path, search_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) as rn
  FROM pre_events
  WHERE session IN (SELECT session FROM qualifying_sessions)
)
SELECT qs.session, qs.pre_click_count, fpe.path, fpe.search_type
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
JOIN first_pre_event fpe ON qs.session = fpe.session AND fpe.rn = 1
ORDER BY qs.session

-- Step 3: Build the full query to find the 3 years with smallest combined total
WITH driver_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, driver_id, SUM(results.points) as driver_total_points
    FROM results
    JOIN races r ON results.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, driver_id
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, constructor_id, SUM(results.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM results
    JOIN races r ON results.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, constructor_id
),
max_driver_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_total_points) as max_driver_points
    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total_points) as max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    md.year,
    md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points as combined_total
FROM max_driver_by_year md
JOIN max_constructor_by_year mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 3

-- Build the full query: for each (constructor, year), find best driver points and combined total
WITH last_races AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_final AS (
  SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
driver_final AS (
  SELECT ds.driver_id, lr.year, ds.points as driver_points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
driver_constructors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.year, dr.driver_id, dr.constructor_id
  FROM drives dr
  WHERE dr.constructor_id > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT dc.constructor_id, dc.year, cf.constructor_points, 
         MAX(df.driver_points) as best_driver_points
  FROM driver_constructors dc
  JOIN constructor_final cf ON dc.constructor_id = cf.constructor_id AND dc.year = cf.year
  JOIN driver_final df ON dc.driver_id = df.driver_id AND dc.year = df.year
  GROUP BY dc.constructor_id, dc.year, cf.constructor_points
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.name as constructor_name, 
         co.year,
         co.constructor_points + co.best_driver_points as combined_points
  FROM combined co
  JOIN constructors c ON co.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.constructor_points + co.best_driver_points DESC) <= 3
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM ranked
ORDER BY combined_points DESC

        MAX(last_round) AS last_race_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
driver_first_constructor AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id AS first_constructor
    FROM drives d
    INNER JOIN driver_season ds 
        ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.first_round = ds.first_race_round
),
driver_last_constructor AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id AS last_constructor
    FROM drives d
    INNER JOIN driver_season ds 
        ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.last_round = ds.last_race_round
),
qualified_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.year,
        ds.driver_id
    FROM driver_season ds
    INNER JOIN driver_first_constructor fc 
        ON ds.year = fc.year AND ds.driver_id = fc.driver_id
    INNER JOIN driver_last_constructor lc 
        ON ds.year = lc.year AND ds.driver_id = lc.driver_id
    WHERE fc.first_constructor = lc.last_constructor
        AND ds.last_race_round > ds.first_race_round
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualified_seasons qs
INNER JOIN drivers d ON qs.driver_id = d.driver_id
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
